dct_description_sm: Color map of the Milky Way shows the entire galaxy in one perspective of a 3-D model. The image incorporates the positions of hundreds of thousands of stars and nebulae within the galaxy, shows Earth's location, and includes 16 insets, descriptions and locations of fascinating phenomena throughout the Milky Way.
David Rumsey Map Center copy 1: Pub list no. 11349.000.
